what: PROCESS-LOG 91, part 1: why a rerun on identical inputs gave 179/411 instead of the committed 178/411 (entry 77). Code and data = main 38082d0 (before the fix), one BLAS thread, fused_knn.main() run by a driver with output to a scratch folder.

p1_standalone.how: fused_knn.main() alone in a fresh process (as run_all.sh runs it)

p2_evalfirst.how: evaluate.main() then fused_knn.main() in ONE process (as a56_offset.py run A did)

cause: gknn.py drew the 3000 random pairs for each group scale (median pair distance) from ONE module-level generator np.random.default_rng(21). Every Bank.dists() call advanced it, so the scale in a fold depended on how many dists() calls the process had made before. evaluate.py calls dists() too; run in the same process before fused_knn.py it shifts the stream: different scales -> different weights/k in some folds -> 179/411. run_all.sh runs each script in its own process, so the committed run (178) was itself reproducible.
